headline: Google has launched Playground, an experimental tool that builds browser games from plain-text prompts.
score_reason: Pool 6, kept: a major company's new consumer AI tool, live from 7 Oct.
importance_line: It lowers the cost of making simple games for people who cannot code, but it is a US-only experiment for adults for now and its quality is not yet tested by outside reviewers.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Google Labs, Google's public experimental platform, launched Playground on Wednesday, 7 Oct 2026, a tool that builds browser games from plain text prompts without coding. Games play on phones and computers and can be shared by link, and the service is limited for now to US users aged 18 and older, with game-making capped by a weekly allowance of tokens, the units AI tools use to measure usage.
